description: This file defines a service module for managing prescriptions in a medical blockchain platform. It includes functions for creating prescriptions, retrieving and listing them, verifying their status, and recording relevant audit logs and blockchain references.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_dict(row: sqlite3.Row)
methods.description: Converts a sqlite3.Row object to a dictionary.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str]] _get_chain_ref(conn: sqlite3.Connection, prescription_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the latest blockchain transaction signature and network for a given prescription ID.

methods.name: None _add_audit_log( conn: sqlite3.Connection, prescription_id: str, action: str, actor_user_id: int, actor_role: str, details: Optional[str] = None, ip_address: Optional[str] = None, user_agent: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Inserts an audit log entry related to prescription actions.

methods.name: int _find_patient_id( conn: sqlite3.Connection, patient_email: Optional[str], patient_public_id: Optional[str] )
methods.description: Finds the patient's internal ID based on email or public ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_prescription( conn: sqlite3.Connection, doctor_user_id: int, doctor_role: str, *, patient_email: Optional[str], patient_public_id: Optional[str], drug_name: str, dosage: Optional[str], quantity: Optional[int], units: Optional[str], frequency: Optional[str], duration_days: Optional[int], instructions: Optional[str], expires_at: Optional[str], issue_on_chain: bool, ip_address: Optional[str] = None, user_agent: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates a new prescription record, optionally recording a stub on-chain reference.

methods.name: sqlite3.Row get_prescription_by_id(conn: sqlite3.Connection, prescription_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a prescription by its unique ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_prescriptions_for_user( conn: sqlite3.Connection, user_id: int, roles: List[str] )
methods.description: Lists prescriptions relevant to a specific user based on roles.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] verify_prescription( conn: sqlite3.Connection, prescription_id: str, pharmacist_user_id: int, pharmacist_role: str, verify_on_chain: bool, mark_verified: bool, ip_address: Optional[str] = None, user_agent: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Verifies a prescription, optionally on-chain, and updates its status.
